yt_title: The Spotlight Effect: Nobody Notices You as Much as You Think #Shorts
desc: In a famous study, students wearing an embarrassing T-shirt thought about half the room would notice. Far fewer did. New fizzy fact every day on Fruit Soda.
caption: Everyone is too busy worrying about themselves. 🔦 Does this help you? Comment below.

lines.text: You think everyone noticed that embarrassing moment.
Psychologists call this the spotlight effect.
In one study, students wore an embarrassing shirt into a room.
They guessed about half the room would notice. Far fewer actually did.
Everyone is busy worrying about themselves. So relax, and go be yourself.
